_what: Read-only forensics: does a Vast rental's CHARGED GPU rate move after rental, or is the apparent rise the storage line in `dph_total`?
_fields: allow-listed — see SAFE_FIELDS. Field NAMES are evidence; token/ssh/address VALUES are credentials and never appear here.

instances.verdict: UNKNOWN — no bid on record for this instance, so the rate it is being charged cannot be compared with the rate it was rented at.

summary: 0 of 0 gradeable live rental(s) show a GPU line differing from the bid agreed at rental (1 of 1 carry no recorded bid and cannot be graded). No graded rental's GPU rate has moved from its bid. An apparent rise on the board is an INSTANCE's `dph_total` (bid + the real volume's disk line) read against an OFFER's `dph_total` (market floor + the disk line the search priced) — two different quantities, not a price move.
